name: Vale
greeting: A room with a window I can open myself. That sounds smaller aloud than it did in my head.
lines: Kael: Not from this side of the wall.
Vale: And work I chose, with people who can tell me no. I spent years being useful to the wrong silence.
Kael: Is there room in that picture for company?
Vale: There could be. But I won't mistake someone needing a ledger for someone wanting to know me.

actions.label: I want to know you, not what you can open for me.

relationship_event.text: After direct acquaintance, Kael expressed adult romantic interest in Vale. She welcomed the question without making a commitment.
relationship_event.acknowledgement: I'm glad you asked about the window. I wanted someone to understand that part.

actions.label: Then let me be someone you can call a friend.

relationship_event.text: Kael and Vale explicitly chose friendship, independent of the archive.
relationship_event.acknowledgement: A friend is welcome here without bringing a request.

actions.label: I can't offer that kind of company. I won't imply otherwise.

relationship_event.text: Kael respectfully declined a personal relationship with Vale.
relationship_event.acknowledgement: Thank you for speaking plainly. The record is still yours to read.
